item.title: Zatu Games marks 10 years with anniversary cashback and mystery boxes
item.description: UK board game retailer Zatu Games celebrates its 10th anniversary with a cashback flash sale and limited-edition mystery birthday bundles.

item.title: From TSR to today: Rose Estes unveils Different and a new fantasy figure line
item.description: TSR legend Rose Estes launches a Kickstarter for her new fantasy novel Different and a series of collectible tabletop figures.

item.title: Minecraft’s console architects open the gates to Reforj pre-alpha
item.description: 4J Studios, the team behind Minecraft on consoles, has released the pre-alpha of its new sandbox title Reforj on Xbox Insider.

item.title: Dating & Dragons: Romance a buff half-orc in this anti-AI dating sim
item.description: Romance a buff half-orc in Dating & Dragons: A Love Quest. This anti-AI dating sim blends visual novel storytelling with TTRPG dice mechanics.

item.title: Mutants & Masterminds 4th Edition: A great superhero RPG returns
item.description: Mutants & Masterminds returns with a 4th Edition on Kickstarter. Steve Kenson updates the classic d20 superhero RPG with new reaction mechanics and streamlined archetypes.

item.title: Rebellion releases free rulebook for Ian Livingstone’s Judge Dredd board game
item.description: Rebellion Unplugged has released the rulebook for Ian Livingstone's classic Judge Dredd board game as a free download. Get the PDF here.

item.title: Routinely Itemised: RPG #348
item.description: Explore the latest roleplaying games news as Hasbro credits AI for profits and Planet of the Apes hits DTRPG. Plus, an exclusive look at a massive project mapping 29,000+ global TTRPG publishers.

item.title: Axolotl with a Gun: The arcade-style RPG where the horrors persist, and so must you
item.description: Play as an adorable amphibian with a heavy arsenal in Axolotl with a Gun 2nd Edition. This coin-op style TTRPG is funding on Kickstarter until Feb 26th.

item.title: Atlas Games launches Fork ICE February charity sale to support Minnesota neighbours
item.description: Minnesota-based Atlas Games is running a daily charity sale throughout February to support local communities affected by federal enforcement actions.

item.title: Audio EXP Podcast #321: Love, Lasers, and Lost Caverns
item.description: Audio EXP #321 covers Atlas Games' charity initiative, Hasbro's controversial AI success, and the sad closure of White Dragon Miniatures. Plus, the return of TSR legend Rose Estes and a review of the new Looney Tunes movie.
